Introduction
------------

This vignette documents the non-coder workflow: edit a YAML plan and run one command.

Portal entrypoint
-----------------

Use files under `portal/`:

- `portal/plans/templates/` for YAML templates
- `portal/run_plan.R` for single-run execution
- `portal/run_sensitivity.R` for sensitivity execution
- `portal/launch_gui_stub.R` for optional GUI

Command-line workflow
---------------------

```bash
# 1) Validate plan only
Rscript portal/run_plan.R portal/plans/templates/single_scenario_template.yaml --dry-run

# 2) Execute
Rscript portal/run_plan.R portal/plans/templates/single_scenario_template.yaml

# 3) Sensitivity example
Rscript portal/run_sensitivity.R portal/plans/templates/sensitivity_template.yaml
```

What to inspect
---------------

After a run, inspect:

- `artefacts/portal_runs/<plan_id_slug>/run_index.csv`
- `artefacts/portal_runs/<plan_id_slug>/tables/*.csv`
- `artefacts/portal_runs/<plan_id_slug>/figures/*.png`
- `artefacts/portal_runs/<plan_id_slug>/reports/*.html`
